name: Raise-A-Wish
source:
Awoken by the end of the world, the girl is thrust unprepared into a futile battle. You watch despairingly as she is torn apart before your eyes. As the foundation of the earth is slowly consumed by decay, you desperately put your hands together to make a wish upon a falling star.

Guide Dizzy, Lumi, Jelly, and Ember through their short yet eventful lives, learn their stories, and raise them as if they've always been yours. Don't let them down!

https://jellyhoshiumi.itch.io/raise-a-wish
